legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–13: title and abstract; introduction; conceptual and clinical-application sections; Tables 1–6; risk-score and imaging discussions; challenges/limitations; future perspectives and conclusion; references. This is a review and has no original methods/results section. The extracted tables were readable. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: Review article about AI in hepatology; included as survey/background. It presents cited examples and general discussion, not a demonstrated healthcare world-model implementation or original model evaluation. A:I were left unchanged. Evidence QA: 2/3 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (66.7%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 4 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Model-assisted source review; no independent human review or verification of cited primary studies.
No own model, empirical cohort, quantitative validation or new instantiated conceptual framework; no readiness facet assigned.
Narrative review has no reproducible search protocol; conceptual comparison of AI/statistics should not be treated as universal technical distinctions.
Cited discrimination results do not establish therapeutic causal effects or patient benefit.
